title: Pitch-accuracy FFT and correlation-sanity tests, preset BinaryData embedding, CMakeLists
description:
Phase-E sole owner of CMakeLists.txt. Add full-path correctness tests and embed factory presets via juce_add_binary_data. Depends on e.1 preset XML files existing.

Before editing, inspect:
- Resources/Presets/*.xml from e.1
- tests/TestMain.cpp, tests/DSPPrimitiveTests.cpp, tests/EngineTests.cpp harness style
- CMakeLists.txt from prior phases (plugin target, ShredWidthTests / add_test, juce_add_binary_data patterns)
- Source/DSP/ShredWidthEngine.h, PitchShifter, MeterTap public APIs
- .abracapocus/ShredWidth_Build_Spec.md §12 (BinaryData), §14 items 7–8 (pitch accuracy, correlation sanity)
- Sibling juce_add_binary_data usage under /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/

Implement:
1. tests/CorrectnessTests.cpp:
   a. Pitch accuracy: drive +ΔC path (PitchShifter alone or engine configured so one side is measurable) with a pure tone at known f (e.g. 1000 Hz @ 48 kHz); FFT the wet/shifted output; assert spectral peak lies within tolerance of f * 2^(ΔC/1200). Document FFT size, hop/window, and cents tolerance. Prefer self-contained radix-2 or simple DFT helper — no new third-party FFT deps if avoidable.
   b. Correlation sanity: with Width=200% and large detune, assert MeterTap/engine ρ drops (wide); with Width=0 assert ρ ≈ 1 (mono); folded-to-mono sum L+R has no null below f_cross (sub-crossover energy retained). Settle past reported latency before measuring.
   c. Follow existing test runner entry patterns (TestMain discovers or links this TU).
2. CMakeLists.txt only this task edits in phase E:
   - juce_add_binary_data (or equivalent) embedding Resources/Presets/{TightLead,WideLead,HugeSolo,MonoSafeSubtle,LiveTracking}.xml into a BinaryData target linked by the plugin (and tests if needed).
   - Register tests/CorrectnessTests.cpp on the existing test executable / add_test path.
   - Do not remove VST3/CLAP/LV2/Standalone, unpin JUCE, or drop prior DSP/GUI sources.

Do not edit RT-safety/pluginval scripts or docs (e.3–e.5). Do not rewrite EngineTests body beyond CMake registration if already present.
acceptance_criteria: tests/CorrectnessTests.cpp exists and includes a pitch-accuracy check using FFT peak vs f*2^(deltaC/1200) within documented tolerance
tests/CorrectnessTests.cpp includes correlation-sanity checks: Width=200% large detune drops rho; Width=0 gives rho near 1; folded mono has no null below f_cross
CMakeLists.txt embeds Resources/Presets XML factory bank via juce_add_binary_data (or equivalent BinaryData target) and links it to the plugin
CMakeLists.txt registers tests/CorrectnessTests.cpp on the test executable / add_test path
CMakeLists.txt still lists prior plugin sources and formats (VST3/CLAP/LV2/Standalone)
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/** DSP/GUI implementation files (consume APIs as written)
modify tests/EngineTests.cpp or tests/DSPPrimitiveTests.cpp bodies unless strictly required for linkage
remove plugin formats or unpin JUCE
add network FetchContent FFT libraries if a small in-tree DFT/FFT helper suffices

allowed: engine-only or PitchShifter-only fixture for pitch FFT
small self-contained FFT/DFT helper in the test TU
name BinaryData target consistently with nSpace siblings
epsilon/tolerance constants documented in test comments
forbidden: own verification shell scripts or manuals
